hero_kpi_rationale: Key growth indicator for stores and online channels open for at least one year, directly reflecting the performance of the core brand portfolio (American Eagle and Aerie)

kpis.name: Comparable Sales
kpis.explanation: Measure of sales growth for stores and online channels open for at least one year, excluding licensed stores
kpis.description: Key performance indicator for retailers showing organic sales growth

kpis.name: Gross Profit
kpis.explanation: Difference between total net revenues and cost of sales, including merchandise costs, markdowns, shrinkage, and procurement expenses
kpis.description: Profitability metric of sales expressed in millions of dollars and as a percentage of revenue

kpis.name: Omni-Channel Sales Performance
kpis.explanation: Assessment of sales performance across omni-channel platforms (stores, online, points of sale) through key metrics including average unit price, number of transactions, units per transaction, and comparable traffic
kpis.description: Composite measure of omni-channel performance used by management to evaluate sales quality and distribution channel efficiency

risks.title: Dependence on consumer discretionary spending
risks.score_rationale: Risk ranked first in the 10-K, with strong language ('material adverse effect') and direct references to past impacts (COVID-19 pandemic). Exacerbated by inflation, interest rates, and geopolitical uncertainty. Macro category highly weighted in the context of cyclical consumer spending.

risks.title: Increased competition and pricing pressure
risks.score_rationale: Text describes intensifying competition, particularly from fast-fashion and e-commerce, with pressure on margins. Repeated language on 'pricing pressure' and 'aggressive pricing'. Central risk in the fashion sector.

risks.title: Difficulty anticipating fashion trends
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned as critical to profitability and reputation. Language emphasizes rapid changes and long production lead times. Less existential than macro risks but key to the business model.

risks.title: Global supply chain vulnerabilities
risks.score_rationale: Text cites risks related to tariffs, geopolitical conflicts, logistics disruptions, and supplier financing shortages. Strong language on 'material adverse effect'. Heightened geopolitical tensions and tariff uncertainty (February 2026) amplify the risk.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and AI-related risks
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly tied to AI use, customer data, and potential legal costs. Although less central than macro risks, the language is alarming with exposure to emerging regulation. Sensitive category in an environment of increasing compliance demands.

risks.title: Seasonality of sales
risks.score_rationale: Well-documented risk, with revenue concentration in two quarters (holidays and back-to-school). Moderate language but risk amplified by other factors (weather, crisis). Less severe as it is structural and anticipated.

risks.title: Exposure to foreign currency fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Risk cited with mention of the Mexican peso and Canadian dollar. Language is measured but repeated across multiple contexts. Less critical than others but contributes to earnings volatility.

ai_positioning.summary: AI is mentioned in the context of cybersecurity and regulatory compliance risks, with concerns around algorithmic bias and legal exposure, but no proactive adoption strategy detected.
evidence: Risk Factor: 'Cybersecurity and AI-related risks' mentioning the use of AI, customer data, and regulatory exposure
